verdict.rationale: Team roles and scoped API keys are a fair question for a GPU cloud provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents team-member management, role-based access, or scoped or limited API keys. Workspaces, workspace SSH keys, and a key-gated API are adjacent at best and do not show roles or credential scoping.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled
